verdict.rationale: One community user cited a public API price of $0.27 per 1M tokens, and the docs reference on-demand pricing and 50% batch discounts, so some self-serve per-token pricing evidently exists. However, another community report says Groq switched to 'call us for quotes' for newer models, which directly contradicts the 'every hosted model without talking to sales' part of the story. missing for 10: a first-party public pricing page listing per-token rates for all hosted models, confirmation that new models are not quote-only, current independent corroboration.
